## Responsibilities

- Chu Junjie (@Chu-Junjie): public SG-Navi repository (owner decision overriding the guide), invite only @Guanyu-Lu and @ZhengZaikun, Task 1–7 Issues, task board, AGENTS.md, PR template and review rules.
- Zheng Zaikun (@ZhengZaikun): minimal Flask server, /api/health, pytest dependencies and GitHub Actions; agreed backend/rag/shared/tests layout. No Rule Engine yet.
- Lu Guanyu (@Guanyu-Lu): English homepage in frontend/ with SG Navi title, Rental Deposit and Consumer Complaint placeholder entries, and actual API health status. No full forms yet.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Repository exists with the owner-approved public visibility; both collaborators accepted with write access; all three can clone.
- [ ] Seven Issues, private task board, PR template and review settings have actual evidence.
- [ ] All three members can start the backend, open the page and run basic tests.
- [ ] /api/health, homepage, pytest and CI have real successful records.
- [ ] Relevant PRs have another developer's review before merge.

Evidence: link docs/task1-checklist.md, PRs, commit and CI run. Do not start Task 2 until this gate passes.
